subject: general
question: Which of the following awards recognises children’s book writers from 22 languages?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bal Sahitya Puraskar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Bal Sahitya Puraskar** is an award presented by the **Sahitya Akademi**, India’s National Academy of Letters, to recognize outstanding contributions in children's literature.
 
• The award covers works written in **22 recognized Indian languages** as per the Eighth Schedule of the Constitution of India, including Hindi, English, Bengali, Tamil, and others.
 
• It is awarded annually and aims to promote **children’s literature** and encourage writers who contribute significantly to this genre.
 
• The award includes a **citation, a shawl, and a monetary prize**, acknowledging the efforts of authors in enhancing literary culture for children.
 
• The **Bal Sahitya Puraskar** was instituted by the Sahitya Akademi in 2010</strong&g
